accepted_findings.finding: Outcome settlement uses first eligible capture after outcome_due_utc, so publication/scheduling lag can change the market observation being scored.
Execution receipts previously conflated structural transport with independent replication for empty FORECAST_TEST requests.
Write-once historical outcomes can preserve verdicts produced by a superseded resolver and require an append-only replay/supersession layer rather than destructive rewrite.
Pending/ratification throughput can materially alter the evaluated forecast population; the 23 observed UP candidates were all outside the frozen/scored family.

review_corrections.subject: Brier interpretation
review_corrections.note: A deterministic categorical forecast can be represented as 0/1 probability and scored by Brier. The supported limitation is narrower: the current forecast contract does not freeze graded ex-ante probabilities, so probabilistic calibration claims are not available. In-sample calibrated-constant Brier values are not accepted as skill evidence.

review_corrections.subject: effective N presentation
review_corrections.note: The reported effective-N arithmetic is consistent with 11*1.074=11.81 and 14*1.090=15.26; a nearby displayed day-count table appears inconsistent. Participation-ratio effective N is retained as a heuristic power diagnostic, not a canonical statistical sample-size estimator.
